The moment you hire your second support agent, Gmail stops working and Zendesk starts feeling like overkill.

That gap is exactly where small teams get stuck — reply collisions, missed tickets, and an inbox that was never built for two people.

We built replydeck for support teams of two to ten. It's a shared inbox that drafts replies in your team's actual voice — not a generic AI voice — because it learns from your own resolved conversations.

Setup is five minutes: forward an address and you're in. No workflow configuration, no implementation consultant, no enterprise contract.

Across our pilot cohort of nine teams, first-response time dropped 40% on average. The largest customer handles 20,000 tickets a month on the standard plan.

$29 per seat, every feature included, 14-day free trial.

If your team is outgrowing Gmail but not ready to become a Zendesk admin, it might be worth a look: {APP_URL}
